# docs(hfp-020): fill in GLOSSARY.md

## Task

`GLOSSARY.md` defines only User and Project. CLAUDE.md and `docs/agents/domain.md` point agents at it as the project's vocabulary. Add the remaining domain terms, using the names in ADR 0004 and the code. Note any term where the code and the ADRs disagree.

Doing this before transcript upload (HFP-011) helps, since that slice introduces most of these terms into the API.

## Parent Story

Domain docs (`docs/agents/domain.md`).

## Blocked by

Nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Entries for: Transcript (and transcript version), Segment, Participant / speaker, Excerpt, Tag, Insight, Evidence, Job card, Desired outcome, Outcome rating, Opportunity score, Tension.
- [ ] Each entry follows the existing format, with _Avoid_ terms where the code or older notes use other words (e.g. "quote" vs. excerpt, "speaker" vs. participant).
- [ ] Where the code uses a different word from ADR 0004, the glossary says which one is the target, and a follow-up is added to `notes/task-list.md`.
